skill_name: Summarize the given article into 5 sentences that include the main points.
workflow: Steven Johnson studies how cities, networks and teams support innovation. He discovered that when diverse ideas, workflows, and people interact with one another, new, creative solutions are formed, which he calls adaptive hotbeds. Johnson believes these adaptive hotbeds are responsible for much of the world's great innovation. Notably, these hotbeds facilitate the dynamic and responsive process of innovation.
